title: Add hybrid RRF ranking to ad search
goal: Long-tail ad searches return too few relevant results because BM25 misses synonyms. Buyers searching 'cheap phone' should see listings titled 'budget smartphone'.
approach: Query the existing BM25 index and the new vector index in parallel, then merge the two ranked lists with reciprocal rank fusion (k = 60). Vector search sits behind the hybrid_ranking flag.

alternatives_rejected.why_not: BM25 and cosine scores live on different scales and would need per-query weight tuning.

alternatives_rejected.option: Re-rank BM25 top 100 with a cross-encoder
alternatives_rejected.why_not: Adds about 80 ms p95 and still can't recover documents BM25 never retrieved.

deliberately_not_done: Did not change the indexing pipeline; vectors come from the nightly batch job
author_flagged_risks: Latency on long-tail queries when the vector index is cold
Relevance regressions on exact-match queries such as model numbers
how_to_verify: Run the relevance eval suite: ./gradlew relevanceEval
Search 'iphone 15' and 'cheap phone' on staging with hybrid_ranking on and off
